open-error.credential-service-unavailable: Windows' credential storage service isn't running, so {{productName}} couldn't finish opening this workspace. Your files are safe. Try again, or restart the "Credential Manager" service (services.msc) if this keeps happening.
open-error.generic: Could not open this workspace. Please try again.

backlinks.empty: No other documents link to this file.

tab-group-manager.title: Tab groups
tab-group-manager.description: Create and organize tab groups to better manage your open files.
tab-group-manager.no-groups: No groups yet. Create one above to get started.
tab-group-manager.drop-to-add: Drop tabs here to add them to this group
tab-group-manager.drag-to-ungroup: Drag tabs here to ungroup them

autosave.unsaved-tooltip: Unsaved changes. Auto-save will run shortly.

presentation.basic-preview: Basic preview, install LibreOffice for full fidelity.
presentation.first-open-converts: First open converts the deck; later opens are instant.
presentation.cannot-preview: Could not preview this file. Download it to view in PowerPoint.

docx-editor.concurrent-edit-conflict: This text changed elsewhere while you were editing it, so your last change wasn't applied. Please make the edit again.
docx-editor.formatting-warning: Some advanced formatting (tables, images, page headers) may not be preserved when saving. A backup of the original file is created before your first edit.
docx-editor.desktop-only: Editing Word documents with tracked changes is only available in the {{productName}} desktop app. Showing a read-only preview here.
docx-editor.reviewing-hint: Show changes. Turn off for final view.
docx-editor.preserved-block: [preserved content - table, section, or other element kept as-is]
docx-editor.final-view-note: Showing the final document. Turn on Review to accept or reject individual changes inline.
docx-editor.draft-follow-up-title: Draft a follow-up email from this document
docx-editor.send-to-wealthbox-disconnected: Connect Wealthbox from Your account → Connections to send notes.
docx-editor.outbound-blocked-checking: Checking this note before it can leave
docx-editor.outbound-blocked-needs-review: Review this note first. It hasn't been checked yet.
docx-editor.outbound-blocked-errored: This note couldn't be generated cleanly. Review it before it leaves.
docx-editor.outbound-blocked-notice-quarantined: This meeting's recording notice needs review before this note can leave.
docx-editor.redline-need-key: Add an account key for your AI provider (AI Assistant → Keys) to use AI redline.
docx-editor.redline-ai-paused: AI redlining is paused while your subscription is inactive. You can still open, edit, and export this document. Resubscribe to turn AI features back on.
docx-editor.redline-egress-note: Sends this document to your AI provider with your key.
docx-editor.export-saved-clean: Saved a clean copy with hidden metadata removed.
docx-editor.export-saved-clean-final: Saved a clean final copy: changes accepted, comments and hidden metadata removed.
docx-editor.save-blocked-title: This document can't be saved right now
docx-editor.save-blocked-body: Another program (often antivirus, backup, or cloud sync) may be blocking the file. Your changes are safe here and I'll keep trying automatically. If it doesn't clear, save a copy somewhere else so nothing is lost.
docx-editor.pdf-needs-libreoffice-body: {{productName}} converts Word to PDF locally using LibreOffice, a free program. Nothing leaves your machine. Install it, then run the export again.

pdf-viewer.no-inline-support: Your browser may not support inline PDF viewing.

rtf-editor.formatting-warning: RTF is a simpler format than Word. Complex formatting (tables, images, custom fonts) may be simplified on save. A backup of the original file is created before your first edit.

manager.info: Whiteboards open as full tabs in the editor.

control.on-body: This workspace's files are encrypted at rest. {{productName}} decrypts them transparently, so your work is unchanged.
control.locked-note: This vault is locked. Reopen the workspace to unlock it with your recovery phrase.

ceremony.cannot-recover-warning: {{productName}} cannot recover this for you. If you lose this phrase and your device's keychain, your encrypted files will be permanently inaccessible.
ceremony.confirm-prompt: Confirm you've saved the phrase. Enter the words at these positions:

enable.title: Encrypt this workspace
enable.subtitle: AES-256 at rest, transparent in {{productName}}
enable.detail: When enabled, every document file in this workspace is stored as ciphertext on disk. {{productName}} decrypts them transparently so your workflow is unchanged.
enable.bullet-names-visible: File names and folder structure remain visible
enable.bullet-phrase-once: A 24-word recovery phrase is generated once. You must save it.
enable.bullet-no-recovery: If you lose the phrase and the keychain, files cannot be recovered
enable.bullet-firm-escrow: A firm admin can recover this vault via escrow
enable.ceremony-subheading: Write it down somewhere safe. Shown once only.
enable.escrow-notice: A firm admin will be able to recover this vault on your behalf using the firm's escrow key. This is in addition to your personal recovery phrase.
enable.encrypting-subtitle: This may take a moment for large workspaces.
enable.done-subtitle: All files are now protected at rest.

locked.title: Vault locked
locked.subtitle: This workspace is encrypted and the key is not on this machine.
locked.explanation: Enter your 24-word recovery phrase to unlock this vault. {{productName}} will restore the key to your keychain so you can open this workspace normally from now on.
locked.phrase-hint: Recovery phrases are 24 words separated by spaces.
locked.escape-hatch: Turn off vault and decrypt files
locked.error-invalid-phrase: That phrase has an invalid format. Check each word and try again.
locked.error-recovery-failed: That phrase is valid, but it does not match this vault. Make sure you are using the correct recovery phrase.

escape-hatch.title: Decrypt this workspace and turn off the vault
escape-hatch.description: This will convert every encrypted file back to a normal, unencrypted file on this disk. The vault will be disabled and removed from this workspace.
escape-hatch.warning-title: After this, at-rest protection reverts to OS disk encryption only.
escape-hatch.warning-body: Your files will be readable by any process that has access to this folder. Make sure your operating system's full-disk encryption is enabled if you handle sensitive documents.
escape-hatch.working: Decrypting files this may take a moment for large workspaces.
escape-hatch.done-message: All files have been decrypted and the vault has been removed. Your files are normal unencrypted files on disk.
